description: This file defines CLI commands for managing compliance export jobs in the Mattermost server, including listing, showing, canceling, downloading, and creating export jobs. It uses the Cobra library for command-line interface structure and interacts with Mattermost's job management API.

methods.name: complianceExportListCmdF
methods.description: Lists compliance export jobs by calling jobListCmdF with specific parameters.

methods.name: complianceExportShowCmdF
methods.description: Fetches and displays details of a specific compliance export job.

methods.name: complianceExportCancelCmdF
methods.description: Cancels a specified compliance export job.

methods.name: complianceExportDownloadCmdF
methods.description: Downloads a compliance export file, with optional renaming based on server suggestion.

methods.name: complianceExportCreateCmdF
methods.description: Creates a new compliance export job with specified type and date range.

methods.name: getStartAndEnd
methods.description: Parses date string or start/end timestamps to determine the job's time range in milliseconds.
